title: NSX Type S in the Loft on a Rainy Autumn Afternoon
label: PARKED & PEACEFUL
description:
Parked & Peaceful: a british racing green Acura NSX Type S in the loft on a rainy autumn afternoon, red and orange trees outside and a warm lamp on. 8 hours of soft rain on the roof, no music, for sleeping, studying, or blocking out the world while you work.

No music. No talking. No sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
